node.title: Affine reflections survive the twenty-fiber SPI interface
node.closure: official-field additive-energy averaging forces at least 1032 disjoint quadratic reflection fibers
node.statement: In the official KoalaBear base field p=2130706433 with H=mu_(2^21), additive-energy averaging over nonzero c forces some reflection x -> c-x to preserve at least 2065 points of H. After removing its possible fixed point, the pencil X^2-cX+gamma has at least 1032 pairwise-disjoint split squarefree quadratic fibers. Since c is nonzero, this reflection does not globally stabilize H. Thus twenty split fibers do not force a global cyclic or dihedral domain quotient; partial affine pullbacks or retained heavy-ruling semantics must also be controlled. This is a route fence, not an MCA counterexample.
